independent_xt60_footprint.pin_convention: Project-defined pin 1 negative/keyed, pin 2 positive/flat; manufacturer drawings do not assign numerical pad numbers
independent_xt60_footprint.drawing_view: Manufacturer 2025V0 PCB LAYOUT is not explicitly labeled top/bottom. Keying at right can be rotated 180 degrees to footprint keying at left. This symmetric two-hole pattern does not require a mirrored footprint.
independent_xt60_footprint.polarity_evidence: Official AMASS product 285 photo 0 shows molded minus on the male angled/keyed end and molded plus on the female flat end. No reliance on stock footprint polarity.
limits: Body location tolerances relative to contact axes are not separately given; maximum-size courtyard calculation assumes centering about the pair midpoint.
KiCad drill 4.6 mm is nominal; fabrication documentation must communicate finished 4.6 +0.1/-0.0 mm if required.
Physical part fit and actual harness polarity remain unverified.
Vertical option is not installed at current J1; current J1 remains horizontal XT60PW-M with 2.7 mm drill.
